PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received files with batch sharing and downloads ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add one-tap sharing of all fully received files, excluding local and previously saved files.
>• Download files sequentially when batch sharing is unavailable, with a retry path after share
>  failures.
>• Cover selection and fallback behavior with unit tests and byte-verified browser downloads; device
>  checks remain manual.
>
Merge Risk 🟡 Medium

Blast radius 🟡 Medium 💥 2 capabilities

- 2 affected capabilities within one bounded functional scope: photo saving integration. - This is one bounded end-to-end integration: the button invokes the batch selector, the selector uses the page's received-file state, and the same handler performs the share/download delivery. - The map, share-sheet, and download code are propagation hops of this one bulk user outcome, not independent capabilities. - Bulk saving is the batch operation in the same bounded photo-saving integration; its fallback calls the shared download helper for each selected received file. - Individual saving is a distinct user operation within the same bounded integration. - It uses the same received-file state and download/share delivery surface, so it is a separate capability but not an independent functional scope.
Sources
[web/index.html\[326-328\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/index.html#L326-L328) ```html // handed over once it was shared or its download started, so Save all doesn't save it again (F13) if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); else { downloadFile(file); saveAll.handed.add(p.pid); } ``` [web/saveall.js\[38-56\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/saveall.js#L38-L56) ```javascript if (!downloadNext) { try { sharing = !!canShare(list); } catch { sharing = false; } } busy = true; try { if (sharing) { try { await share(list); } catch (e) { if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available downloadNext = true; return toast('Couldn’t open the share sheet. Tap Save all again to download'); } for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } downloadNext = false; // download mode lasts one batch toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ``` [web/index.html\[335-343\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/index.html#L335-L343) ```html // Save all (F13): every received photo in one tap. The share sheet once with all of them, or downloads const saveAll = createSaveAll({ batch: (handed) => saveBatch({ prints, files, incoming, me: id, handed }), canShare: (list) => !!navigator.share && !!navigator.canShare?.({ files: list }), share: (list) => navigator.share({ files: list }), download: downloadFile, toast, }); $('saveall').onclick = () => saveAll.tap(); ```
Behavioral complexity 🔴 High 🧩 Multiple interactions

- Before: individual saving had no bulk batch state, busy lock, retry mode, or per-file handed invariant. - After: Save all adds share-versus-download selection, AbortError versus other failure handling, a one-batch download fallback, delayed per-file marking, 400 ms ordering, and re-entry suppression while asynchronous work is active. - New correctness conditions: a file must be marked only after its handoff starts or completes as defined, a failed share must not silently discard files, a concurrent tap must not start a second batch, and a partial download batch must remain retryable. - The wait primitive itself is routine; the complexity comes from the newly interacting states and ordering protocol.
Sources
[web/saveall.js\[38-56\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/saveall.js#L38-L56) ```javascript if (!downloadNext) { try { sharing = !!canShare(list); } catch { sharing = false; } } busy = true; try { if (sharing) { try { await share(list); } catch (e) { if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available downloadNext = true; return toast('Couldn’t open the share sheet. Tap Save all again to download'); } for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } downloadNext = false; // download mode lasts one batch toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ```
Potential damage 🟡 Medium 🩹 Recoverable

- The affected user outcome is that one or more received photos are not saved, or a photo must be saved again. - The files remain in the in-memory files map and the code intentionally leaves a per-file item unmarked when download\(\) throws, so a later tap can retry. - A failed share handoff sets a download-on-next-tap mode rather than mutating persistent application state. - If an incorrect state transition marks a file too early, recovery requires another supported retry or a page/session reset; the source does not show persistent data corruption or irreversible external effects. - Reverting the page restores the prior individual-save behavior, but does not repair a file already missed or incorrectly handed over. - During the active session, retrying Save all can recover files that remain unmarked; files already marked handed require a fresh page/session or another source copy. - No automatic worker or scheduler repairs this state.
Sources
[web/saveall.js\[38-56\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/saveall.js#L38-L56) ```javascript if (!downloadNext) { try { sharing = !!canShare(list); } catch { sharing = false; } } busy = true; try { if (sharing) { try { await share(list); } catch (e) { if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available downloadNext = true; return toast('Couldn’t open the share sheet. Tap Save all again to download'); } for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } downloadNext = false; // download mode lasts one batch toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ``` [web/index.html\[335-343\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/18ba6fb0cf8bdc546b932383e50463cac3c6031e/web/index.html#L335-L343) ```html // Save all (F13): every received photo in one tap. The share sheet once with all of them, or downloads const saveAll = createSaveAll({ batch: (handed) => saveBatch({ prints, files, incoming, me: id, handed }), canShare: (list) => !!navigator.share && !!navigator.canShare?.({ files: list }), share: (list) => navigator.share({ files: list }), download: downloadFile, toast, }); $('saveall').onclick = () => saveAll.tap(); ```
Assessed commit 18ba6fb
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD UI["Save all tap"] --> Batch["Eligible files"] --> Choice{"Batch share?"} -->|yes| Share["Share sheet"] -->|success| Handed["Handed IDs"] Choice -->|no| Downloads["Paced downloads"] --> Handed Share -->|failure, next tap| Downloads --> Handed ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep the separate, testable selection and save controller with browser APIs supplied by the page. One batch share matches the intended phone interaction, while paced downloads serve browsers without it; per-file share prompts or a ZIP would change that experience.
